facts.fact: A Ministry of Education circular says the KEMIS Learner Validation Engine is operational and automatically compares learner records against official examination and assessment databases, marking learners Valid or Invalid.

The circular says a Unique Learner Identifier is generated in KEMIS only once parent or guardian identification details are complete, and that this is essential for integration with national identity and civil registration records.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, State Department for Basic Education
